subject: Renewal review & Q2 usage export
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@voltrek.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal review & Q2 usage export

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — we’re starting our renewal planning at Voltrek and I wanted to get a quick read on Q2 usage before we lock in numbers with procurement. We shipped a new in-product assistant in mid-June and have seen an uptick in generation volume — want to confirm how that maps to committed tokens and whether a capacity bump makes sense.

Can you send a short usage snapshot and any notes on observed latency/quality during our peak? Also curious about options for a short-term burst pool while we decide on a longer commit. Procurement will want a timeline by next week.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product
Voltrek

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up. I can pull a concise Q2 usage export and a short ROI/latency snapshot and get it over today.

Quick note: for an initial read I’ll include week-by-week token trends, 95th‑percentile latency at peak, and a preliminary recommendation for a 90-day burst pool to smooth the ramp from the new assistant.

Available for a 30‑minute sync tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT or Friday 09:00–12:00 PT — which works for you?

Best,
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@voltrek.com>
Date: 2027-08-24T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Q2 usage snapshot + short ROI recap (attached)
Attachments: voltrek_q2_usage.pdf (PDF), redwood_q2_roi_summary.xlsx (Spreadsheet)

Elena — attached are the Q2 export and a short ROI summary. High level:
- Total token spend (generations + embeddings): 18.7M tokens in Q2 (up 68% vs Q1)
- Peak daily volume: 1.2M tokens (Jul 14) — coincided with the assistant launch
- 95th‑pct latency at peak: 420ms on our hosted model variant; median stayed ~110ms
- Cost implication: on-demand spend would increase ~2.9x without commit; current commit utilization is at ~82% monthly average

Recommendation (short + medium term):
1) 90-day burst pool: 100k burst tokens to avoid throttling while adoption stabilizes
2) Commit uplift: increase monthly committed tokens by 25% vs current run-rate; move to a 12‑month tier with a step-down review at month 6
3) Canary for Dedicated/High‑throughput path: run a 2-week canary on 2 GPU pods to validate latency improvements for peak workloads (plan attached: voltrek_canary_plan.pdf)

If helpful I summarized the economic impact at the bottom of the ROI spreadsheet — shows projected per‑token unit cost drop of ~18% under the commit uplift + batching suggestions.

Let me know if you want me to propose concrete dollar terms and the minimal lead time required for Dedicated capacity. Happy to run this in a quick call.

Jordan

Thanks — that snapshot is exactly what procurement asked for. A couple quick questions before we set a time:
1) If we pursued Dedicated, what ballpark discount should we expect at our current run‑rate + proposed 25% commit uplift?
2) Can the canary validate latency under our 99th‑percentile traffic spikes? Several of our teams are sensitive to 99th latency.

We’re tentatively targeting a sign-off by the 31st (end of month) if terms look reasonable. I’ll bring procurement and legal to the call.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal review & Q2 usage export

Forwarding Voltrek thread — they asked specifically about Dedicated discounts, 99th‑pct latency validation, and SOC2 artifacts. High priority: procurement wants a decision by 31st.

Notes for the team:
- Current Q2: 18.7M tokens (68% QoQ growth). Recommend offering a 12‑month commit with a 6‑month review clause.
- Proposal: commit uplift + 90‑day burst window + canary for 99th‑pct validation.
- Ask: what discount tiers can we offer for a 12‑month commit at +25% token uplift? Also need a streamlined SOC2 packet and a DocuSign envelope ready for quick sign-off.

Can you two take lead on pricing + legal/ops artifacts? I’ll run the canary plan with infra once pricing is agreed.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-26T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal review & Q2 usage export
Attachments: renewal_offer_VOL-2027-081.pdf (PDF)

Team — draft offer attached. High level:
- Term: 12 months
- Commit uplift: 25% increase in monthly committed tokens over current run‑rate
- Pricing: 15% off on-demand rate for committed usage; additional 5% performance rebate if monthly 95th‑pct latency < 300ms for 3 consecutive months
- Burst credits: 100k one-time credit for the initial 90-day window
- SLA: standard Dedicated SLA; escalation playbook included in the offer appendix

I flagged a discretionary 5% commercial credit we can apply at renewal if procurement pushes. We should be ready to share SOC2 + audit pack links and a DocuSign envelope.

If we want a stronger commercial, we can trade an earlier invoice schedule for +3% off — but I recommend keeping that in reserve.

— Lauren
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — attaching a formal offer (VOL-2027-081) and the canary plan for the 2‑week Dedicated validation. Summary below:
- 12‑month term with 25% commit uplift
- 15% off on-demand rate for committed usage + 100k 90‑day burst credit
- Performance rebate: additional 5% if 95th‑pct latency < 300ms for 3 months
- Canary: 2‑week run on 2 GPU pods; objective: validate 99th‑pct latency reduction under peak and confirm request routing/auto‑fallback behavior

Timeline: procurement & legal review this week → sign by 31 Aug → canary scheduled in week of Sep 6 (if signed).

Link to SOC2 and audit pack: https://drive.google.com/voltrek/audit-pack
DocuSign envelope (preview): https://app.docusign.com/documents/VOL-2027-081

Let us know what additional artifacts procurement needs. Happy to jump on a call with your legal/procurement.

Jordan
